name: Prime Cabinet Bonding (Brush)
intent: Brush one coat of bonding primer on factory-finished cabinet surfaces (melamine, thermofoil, laminate). Fires only when substrate_state is SS_FACTORY_FINISH and application_method is brush.

tasks.name: Brush Bonding Primer on Cabinet Doors
Brush Bonding Primer on Cabinet Drawers
Brush Bonding Primer on Cabinet Frame
Brush Bonding Primer on Cabinet Interior

doctrine: Bonding primer on factory-finished surfaces. Rates ~10% slower than wood primer brush due to thicker film required for adhesion. Material system: SYS_PRIMER_BONDING.
